events.name: Bash
events.head: Check remote state and T-237 files
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin 2>&1|tail -2; git ls-remote origin main; for c in a67da2c; do git branch -r --contains $c 2>&1|head -2; done; git log --oneline origin/main -- cloud/src/webinar.ts app/scripts/probe-webinar-signup.mjs | head; git status --short cloud/ app/scripts/probe-webinar-signup.mjs; wc -l cloud/src/webinar.ts app/scripts/probe-webinar-signup.mjs

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check migration, wiring, zoom settings, T-234 hooks
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; cat cloud/migrations/0025_webinar_signups.sql | head -30; grep -n "webinar" cloud/src/index.ts | head -20; grep -n "registrants_confirmation_email\|approval_type\|kind = 'webinar'\|webinarMeeting" cloud/src/zoom-pro.ts | head; grep -rln "tantra_webinar_campaign\|tantraReminder\|T-234" cloud/src | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find T-234 mechanism and status
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "T-234" cloud/src/*.ts | head -15; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py show T-234 2>/dev/null | head -30 || python3 -c "import json;t=[x for x in json.load(open('workshop-plan/tasks/tasks.json'))['tasks'] if x['id']=='T-234'][0];print(t['status'],t['title']);print(t.get('needs_from_owner'));print(t['spec'][:800])"

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -o 'SIM_PORT=[^"\\]\{0,300\}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-237.json | head -4; grep -o 'wrangler dev[^"\\]\{0,200\}' workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-237.json | sort -u | head -4
